original_defect: Zero rows can give q_j=0, so the old exact-k normalized-ensemble claim is invalid without handling those slots. Different column isometries can change only row phases or descriptions; infinitely many isometries alone does not prove physically different ensembles.

substantive_reconstruction.complex_identity: Write u_l=sqrt(p_l)psi_l. The coefficient of |u_l><u_m| in sum_j|w_j><w_j| is sum_j V_jl conjugate(V_jm)=(V†V)_(m,l)=delta_ml. The sum is rho, including complex entries and dependent or zero starting u_l. Trace gives sum_j||w_j||²=1. No transpose substitutes for the adjoint.
substantive_reconstruction.zero_outputs: Set q_j=||w_j||². For q_j>0, phi_j=w_j/sqrt(q_j) is unit; at q_j=0, definiteness gives w_j=0, so discard it or assign its zero-weight slot an arbitrary unit vector. The latter exists because a trace-one state has nonzero carrier. Thus at most k positive components are guaranteed. Appending a zero row to an isometry exhibits the missing boundary.
substantive_reconstruction.redundancy: Multiplying output rows by unit phases leaves q_j and each normalized rank-one projector unchanged. Row permutations, zero padding and split duplicate rays also need not change the physical ensemble. Hence the candidate correctly declines to infer injectivity or genuine variation from the parameter space alone.
substantive_reconstruction.genuine_variation: A mixed finite density state has rank s>=2. Choose two positive spectral components u=sqrt(lambda1)e1,v=sqrt(lambda2)e2. The stated two-row rotation is a column isometry, and its output norms are lambda1 cos²theta+lambda2 sin²theta and lambda1 sin²theta+lambda2 cos²theta, both positive. On0<theta<pi/4, w1 has positive e2/e1 ratio sqrt(lambda2/lambda1)tan(theta), strictly increasing; w2 has negative ratio. No phase/permutation equates these rays across distinct theta, and untouched eigenvectors lie outside their span. Repeated eigenvalues do not stop ray variation. This yields infinitely many ensembles of rho and alternatives to any fixed initial ensemble, without assuming that initial ensemble was spectral.
substantive_reconstruction.longer_witness: The displayed3-by-2 coefficient columns have norms1 and inner product0. Adding s-2 identity columns/rows gives an(s+1)-by-s column isometry. Outputs u/sqrt2,u/2+v/sqrt2,-u/2+v/sqrt2 have weights lambda1/2,lambda1/4+lambda2/2 twice; these sum to lambda1+lambda2 and are positive. Independence of u,v makes all three rays distinct and unlike untouched eigenvectors. Thus this is a genuine existential length increase from the positive rank-s spectral ensemble, not a guarantee for every k>r or every V.
substantive_reconstruction.boundaries: Rank0 is excluded by trace1; rank1 is outside the mixed-state demand. Zero eigenvalues are omitted only from the positive spectral witness, not silently forbidden in the supplied ensemble. The proof makes no HJW reachability classification, efficient numerical construction, gate cost or local Lean-closure claim.
